system.description:
Something made a deal somewhere in your bloodline. You didn't ask for this power — but you have it.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Fire resistance.
  • Once per day when a creature damages you, they take fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier — no save.
  • You have advantage on Persuasion and Deception checks involving contracts, deals, or negotiations, and always know when a written agreement contains a hidden clause.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, offer a creature a binding deal (Will save to refuse).
  • If they accept and break it they lose 3d6 HP per day until honoured — no magical cure works until the debt is paid.
  • A creature that refuses outright takes no harm; one that accepts and then breaks the deal is also marked, and other fiends will pursue it.
  • You always know the location of a marked creature.
